body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified at e4b58abe.

Defects (facts at that commit):
1. packages/init/lib/scaffold.mjs writeOrReconcileConfig: when `.adlc/config.json` is a valid object whose `harnesses` field is an array, string, number or null, `adlc init --harness X` records the file as unchanged, emits no warning and exits 0 with ok:true; X is never registered.
2. packages/init/lib/scaffold.mjs evaluateEffectiveGitignoreContract falls back to a hand-written matcher whenever `git check-ignore --no-index` exits other than 0/1 (root not yet a git repository, git refusing the repository, git absent). That matcher does not model git's rule that nothing under an excluded directory can be re-included, does not know `?` or `[...]`, and reports fewer ignored paths than git for `*/` + `!.adlc/config.json`, `.adlc/**` + partial negations, and `.adlc/config.jso?`. The outcome is `.gitignore` reported unchanged with exit 0 while required ADLC paths are uncommittable.
3. The same matcher builds a RegExp from the raw pattern escaping only `.`, so any .gitignore line containing `build(`, `c++/` or `foo)bar` throws SyntaxError and aborts `adlc init` with exit 1 after config and ticket store were written.
4. The init git probe spawns git with the parent environment, so an exported GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE redirects it to another repository (a correct .gitignore is reported mis-ordered) and ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY is inherited. The sibling probes in gate-manifest enable and tickets manifest-primitives scrub these.
5. packages/init ensureGitignore appends `# ADLC runtime` plus only the missing stanza lines at the end of the file. When `.adlc/*` is missing and a stanza negation such as `!.adlc/config.json` already sits earlier, the appended anchor overrides that negation; init records `updated`, then warns that the rules are mis-ordered and exits 1 on every rerun.
6. packages/consensus-fix runs the repro and rails commands with a blocking execFileSync while registering SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP handlers. A signal received while a candidate's hunks are on disk is not dispatched until the run finishes: with --apply the winner is written and the process exits 0; with SIGTERM followed by SIGKILL the candidate stays in the tree. The existing signal tests only signal during the pre-flight run, and the README and docs page promise restore on any of the three signals.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. `packages/init`: bin/adlc-init.mjs (CLI, ok=false on any non-advisory warning), lib/scaffold.mjs (scaffold, config reconcile, ensureGitignore), lib/gitignore-defaults.mjs (canonical stanza, frozen rail of another ticket; do not edit). `packages/consensus-fix`: bin/consensus-fix.mjs (CLI, signal handlers, --apply), lib/runner.mjs (runCommand, runConsensusFix), lib/snapshot.mjs (snapshot/restore/atomic writes). Tests: `npm test -w packages/init`, `npm test -w packages/consensus-fix`. packages/init/test/misordered-gitignore.test.mjs pins defects 2 and 5 in two assertions and must be rewritten; packages/consensus-fix/test/runner.test.mjs calls runCommand synchronously and must await it.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. init, with --harness given and a present `harnesses` field that is not a plain object: record the warning ".adlc/config.json exists but `harnesses` is not an object; cannot register --harness <x>", leave the file byte-identical, exit 1. Without --harness the field is left alone with no warning.
2. The gitignore contract (lib/gitignore-contract.mjs, re-exported from lib/scaffold.mjs under the existing names) is decided by `git check-ignore` in the root when git answers there; otherwise by `git check-ignore` in a throwaway repository containing only the .gitignore lines; only when git cannot run at all by a JavaScript matcher that models git's last-match-wins, parent-directory exclusion, anchoring, `*`, `?`, `[...]`, `**` and escapes, and never throws on regex metacharacters.
3. Every git child of the probe receives the environment with ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY, GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE removed.
4. When the .gitignore has no `.adlc/*` anchor, init removes stanza lines already present and appends the whole canonical stanza in order; a rerun reports `.gitignore` unchanged and exits 0. A file that already has the anchor keeps today's behaviour (append missing lines; warn and exit 1 on a mis-ordered result).
5. consensus-fix runCommand is asynchronous, runs `sh -c` in its own process group and accepts an AbortSignal; aborting sends SIGTERM to the group, SIGKILL after 2 s, and resolves only after the command exited. runConsensusFix takes `signal`, stops the fan await or in-flight command on abort, restores its snapshot and rejects with RunAbortedError. The bin aborts on SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP, restores the pre-run snapshot, applies nothing and exits 1.
6. Documentation: update packages/init/README.md and packages/consensus-fix/README.md and make the same edits by hand in apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/init.mdx and apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/consensus-fix.mdx; the consensus-fix text names SIGKILL of consensus-fix itself as the uncovered case.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Non-object `harnesses` with --harness warns, leaves the file and exits 1. verify: `node --test packages/init/test/config-harnesses-shape.test.mjs`
- AC2 The JavaScript matcher agrees with git on the differential corpus, never throws on metacharacters, outside a repository the verdict comes from git, and without a git binary a parent-directory exclusion fails closed. verify: `node --test packages/init/test/gitignore-fallback-fidelity.test.mjs`
- AC3 The probe ignores an exported GIT_DIR and its git child sees none of the scrubbed variables. verify: `node --test packages/init/test/gitignore-probe-env.test.mjs`
- AC4 A stanza negation above a missing anchor ends up after it, all required paths are committable, and a rerun exits 0 unchanged. verify: `node --test packages/init/test/gitignore-anchor-repair.test.mjs`
- AC5 SIGINT, SIGTERM and SIGHUP during a candidate's repro run, and SIGTERM during its rails run, exit 1 within 1.5 s with the original file restored, no winner applied and no surviving grandchild; runCommand abort kills the process group and does not start when pre-aborted. verify: `node --test packages/consensus-fix/test/signal-mid-evaluation.test.mjs`
- AC6 README and docs mirror carry the same termination-signal guarantee including the SIGKILL gap. verify: `node --test packages/consensus-fix/test/signal-docs.test.mjs`
- AC7 Existing suites green. verify: `npm test -w packages/init && npm test -w packages/consensus-fix`
- AC8 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: reordering an existing file that already has the `.adlc/*` anchor (init keeps warning); changing the canonical stanza in gitignore-defaults.mjs; consensus-fix candidate agreement or region logic; recovering a candidate left by SIGKILL of consensus-fix itself.
title: init, consensus-fix: fail closed on unverifiable gitignore and unregistrable harness, and restore files on termination during evaluation
